note.sr: Sva otvorena pitanja ka timovima na jednom mestu, stanje posle prijema do 30.10. Svaka stavka kaže šta je pouzdano, šta nije i ko to može da potvrdi. Nerazrešeno se ne pogađa i ne briše — stoji ovde dok ne stigne odgovor; razrešeno nestaje sa spiska.
note.en: All open questions to the teams in one place, as of the intakes up to 30 Oct. Each item states what is reliable, what is not, and who can confirm it. Unresolved items are neither guessed nor deleted — they stand here until an answer arrives; resolved ones leave the list.

items.sr: T70: naslov mejla podneska nosi 64/2026, telo istog mejla 62/2026. Indeks 62/2026 već pripada drugom studentu u T28 (T11 ima 164/26, ne 64/26).
items.en: T70: the submission’s mail subject says 64/2026, the body of the same mail says 62/2026. Index 62/2026 already belongs to another student in T28 (T11 holds 164/26, not 64/26).
items.askSr: T70: koji je tačan broj indeksa?
items.askEn: T70: which index number is correct?

items.sr: T28: podnesak vezuje indekse 33 i 62 za prezimena obrnuto od registra. Razlikuje se i pisanje jednog od ta dva prezimena.
items.en: T28: the submission links indexes 33 and 62 to the surnames in the reverse order from the register. The spelling of one of the two surnames also differs.
items.askSr: T28: koji član nosi 33, a koji 62, i kako se prezime tačno piše?
items.askEn: T28: which member holds 33 and which 62, and how is the surname spelled exactly?

items.sr: Ušće Tower (T72): mejlom od 24. 10. tim navodi 129/26, 18/26 i 69/26, a 18/26 i 69/26 već stoje u T54 i T51. Do 03.11. ovaj tim je bio upisan pod T21; T21 (135/26, 107/26, 114/26) radi Kulu Beograd, ali indekse u predajama nije naveo. Prilozi iz mejla od 24.10. nisu stigli.
items.en: Ušće Tower (T72): an email of 24 Oct lists 129/26, 18/26 and 69/26, but 18/26 and 69/26 already exist in T54 and T51. Until 3 Nov this team was filed under T21; T21 (135/26, 107/26, 114/26) works on Kula Beograd but has not stated its indices in any submission. The attachments from the 24 Oct email never arrived.
items.askSr: T72: koji su tačni indeksi i gde su prilozi o načinu gradnje Ušća 2? T21: potvrdite indekse u sledećoj predaji.
items.askEn: T72: which indices are correct, and where are the Ušće 2 construction attachments? T21: confirm your indices in the next submission.

items.sr: Prva beogradska gimnazija sada ima dva tima. Nosilac 93/2026 piše u množini, ali ostale članove ne imenuje; još jedan student radi na istom objektu, a nije ni u jednoj listi.
items.en: Prva beogradska gimnazija now has two teams. The holder of 93/2026 writes in the plural but does not name the others; one more student works on the same object yet appears in neither list.
items.askSr: T69: ko su članovi? Student na istom objektu: u kom si timu?
items.askEn: T69: who are the members? Student on the same object: which team are you in?

items.sr: Hotel Jugoslavija (T46): podnesci od 23.10. i 27.10. vezani su samo objektom, a pošiljalac dopune nije u registru T46 (89/26, 143/26, 153/26). Dve kule Beograd: istraživanje od 27.10. pripada T21 (ispravka 03.11).
items.en: Hotel Jugoslavija (T46): the submissions of 23 and 27 Oct are tied only to the object, and the sender of the supplement is not in the T46 register (89/26, 143/26, 153/26). Dve kule Beograd: the research of 27 Oct belongs to T21 (corrected 3 Nov).
items.askSr: T46: koji indeksi čine tim i da li pošiljalac dopune pripada timu?
items.askEn: T46: which indices form the team, and does the sender of the supplement belong to it?

items.sr: Hotel Moskva: prepiska sa hotelom i Zavodom (28.10.) dodeljena je T54 po temi (autorstvo), ali podnosilac nije u registru i indeksi oba tima na objektu (T29 enterijer, T54 autorstvo) nisu potvrđeni. Knjiga „Prvih 100 godina hotel Moskva“ koju je hotel poslao nije prosleđena.
items.en: Hotel Moskva: the correspondence with the hotel and the Institute (28 Oct) was assigned to T54 by topic (authorship), but the sender is not in the register and the indices of both teams on the object (T29 interior, T54 authorship) are unconfirmed. The book “The first 100 years of Hotel Moskva” sent by the hotel was not forwarded.
items.askSr: T54 i T29: potvrdite indekse; T54: prosledite PDF knjige koju je hotel poslao.
items.askEn: T54 and T29: confirm your indices; T54: forward the PDF of the book the hotel sent.

items.sr: Podnesak „Ложионица“ potpisale su tri studentkinje; 17/26 se vodi i u T10 (Pančevo) i u T04, a dve nove članice nemaju indeks u predaji — verovatno 15/26 i 90/26.
items.en: The „Ložionica“ submission is signed by three students; 17/26 is listed both in T10 (Pančevo) and in T04, and the two new members carry no index in the submission — probably 15/26 and 90/26.
items.askSr: 17/26: u kom timu radiš? T04: potvrdite indekse dve nove članice.
items.askEn: 17/26: which team are you in? T04: confirm the indices of the two new members.

items.sr: T71 (Miloša Pocerca 32): 30.10. potvrđen drugi član (13/26g) i katastarska parcela (KP 1283/1 KO Savski venac), ali 28 zapisa u pasošu još uvek navodi izvore samo opisno i čeka se izvod iz G-lista o statusu spomenika kulture.
items.en: T71 (Miloša Pocerca 32): on 30 Oct the second member (13/26g) and parcel (KP 1283/1 KO Savski venac) were confirmed, but 28 claims in the passport still cite sources only descriptively and the G-sheet extract on cultural monument status is awaited.
items.askSr: T71: pošaljite konkretne linkove/signature za 28 opisnih izvora i izvod iz G-lista.
items.askEn: T71: send concrete links/shelfmarks for the 28 descriptive sources and the G-sheet extract.

items.sr: Šest arhivskih crteža Kongresnog centra (Sava centar, Blok 19) — osnove, presek, situacioni plan i potpisana izjava projekanata — stiglo je bez ikakve poruke i bez podnosioca.
items.en: Six archive drawings of the Congress Centre (Sava Centar, Block 19) — plans, section, site plan and a signed statement of the project engineers — arrived with no message and no sender.
items.askSr: Čiji je ovaj prilog — T03, T60 ili neko treći?
items.askEn: Whose submission is this — T03, T60, or a third team?

items.sr: „Beogradski arhitriptih“ (AI aplikacija, prijemi 23. i 25.10.) stigao je kao zajednički rad T01, T02 i T03 i vodi se bez tima, jer nije jasno ko je autor kog dela.
items.en: The “Belgrade architriptych” (AI application, intakes of 23 and 25 Oct) arrived as joint work of T01, T02 and T03 and is filed without a team, as it is unclear who authored which part.
items.askSr: T01, T02, T03: ko je radio koji deo i da li se rad računa svakom timu posebno?
items.askEn: T01, T02, T03: who did which part, and does the work count for each team separately?

items.sr: Pasoš Hale 1 (T47, 31 zapis) navodi 18 izvora samo po naslovu, bez linka ili signature; poređenje sa CNIT-om stoji kao nepotvrđeno.
items.en: The Hall 1 passport (T47, 31 records) lists 18 sources by title only, without link or shelfmark; the comparison with CNIT stands as unconfirmed.
items.askSr: T47: pošaljite link, signaturu ili stranu za svaki od 18 izvora.
items.askEn: T47: send a link, shelfmark or page for each of the 18 sources.

items.sr: Dom omladine (T05): tabelarni deo pasoša ima izvore, opisni deo (10 zapisa) nema nijedan, pa su ti zapisi objavljeni kao nepotvrđeni.
items.en: Dom omladine (T05): the tabular part of the passport cites sources, the descriptive part (10 records) cites none, so those records are published as unconfirmed.
items.askSr: T05: dopišite izvor uz svaku tvrdnju opisnog dela.
items.askEn: T05: add a source to each claim in the descriptive part.

items.sr: Kula Beograd (T21): pasoš od 27.10. sam ostavlja sedam pitanja bez odgovora (objavljena su kao „nepoznato“), a tvrdnja o investitoru iz UAE nema izvor.
items.en: Kula Beograd (T21): the passport of 27 Oct itself leaves seven questions unanswered (published as “unknown”), and the claim about the UAE investor has no source.
items.askSr: T21: odgovori na sedam otvorenih pitanja iz vašeg dosijea i izvor za investitora.
items.askEn: T21: answers to the seven open questions in your dossier and a source for the investor.

items.sr: Narodna banka (T16 i T55), Beograđanka (T50), Palata SANU / Glavna pošta (T13) i West 65 Tower (T63) objavljeni su u javnom sloju bez izvora vezanih uz pojedinačne podatke; dosijei nose „Napomenu nastavnika“ i nepotvrđene tvrdnje dok ne stigne tabelarna verzija sa izvorima (T31 je 30.10. dostavio tabelu sa izvorima i prešao u prihvaćeno).
items.en: National Bank (T16 and T55), Beograđanka (T50), SASA Palace / Main Post Office (T13) and West 65 Tower (T63) were published without sources tied to individual records; their dossiers carry a “Teacher’s note” and unconfirmed claims until a tabular sourced version arrives (T31 submitted its sourced table on 30 Oct and moved to accepted).
items.askSr: T16, T50, T13, T55, T63: pošaljite verziju pasoša sa izvorom uz svaki podatak; ona zamenjuje dosije.
items.askEn: T16, T50, T13, T55, T63: send a passport version with a source per record; it replaces the dossier.

items.sr: Zgrada RTS (T15): odeljak „Šta znamo o unutrašnjosti“ ima četiri zapisa koje tim sam označava kao nepoznate.
items.en: RTS building (T15): the section “What we know about the interior” has four records the team itself marks as unknown.
items.askSr: T15: da li četiri nepoznata podatka ostaju otvorena ili imate izvor?
items.askEn: T15: do the four unknown items stay open, or do you have a source?

items.sr: Iz brzih beleški sa konsultacija isti brojevi se javljaju dvaput: 8, 25, 26, 27, 47, 56 i 106. Parovi 49/26g i 49/26, 36/26g i 36/26 verovatno su dva različita studenta (arhitektura / građevina).
items.en: From the quick consultation notes the same numbers appear twice: 8, 25, 26, 27, 47, 56 and 106. The pairs 49/26g and 49/26, 36/26g and 36/26 are probably two different students (architecture / civil engineering).
items.askSr: Ako je tvoj broj gore, javi puni oblik indeksa sa oznakom smera.
items.askEn: If your number is listed above, report the full index including the programme suffix.

items.sr: Zapisi uz 15/25g i 36/26g kažu samo „spisak izvođača”, bez objekta.
items.en: The notes for 15/25g and 36/26g say only “list of contractors”, with no object named.
items.askEn: 15/25g and 36/26g: which building are you researching?

items.sr: Pred kolokvijum 16.11. digitalni trag skica (ručno crtan materijal) postoji za {skice} od {timova} timova, trag AI aplikacije za {ai}. Ostali timovi možda rade, ali evidencija to ne vidi.
items.en: Ahead of the colloquium on 16 Nov, a digital trace of sketches (hand-drawn material) exists for {skice} of {timova} teams, and of the AI application for {ai}. Other teams may be working, but the record does not see it.
items.askSr: Svi timovi: pošaljite fotografije skica i link AI aplikacije pre 16.11.
items.askEn: All teams: send photographs of your sketches and the AI application link before 16 Nov.
